title: MayFall emphasizes the uncomfortable feeling of leaving a relationship behind with “Different Lanes”
htmlContent:
MayFall’s latest single, “Different Lanes,” captures mixed feelings, showing how hard it can be to let go. Some breakups are clean and easy to move on from, while others linger and bother us much longer.

Justin Koetsier’s voice draws you into the emotional struggles after a relationship ends. The creative guitar playing by Steve Doucet and Piero Montemurro adds to the mood, sometimes driving and uplifting and sometimes uncertain and reflective as if they’re rethinking the path ahead. Jay Forhan’s steady bassline is the song’s heartbeat, keeping everything grounded amid the emotional ups and downs.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4bDnaaRz6msmkn3qL6QTi8?si=43mdINFLQ3WAv6YwlQ4iuw

“Different Lanes” is for anyone feeling stuck between what was and what could be. MayFall captures the essence of heartbreak in a way that resonates, leaving listeners with the understanding that some journeys are not meant to be shared forever. The music builds and shifts, mirroring the struggle between holding on to the past and looking toward the future.
